name: after5-tts-sheet-voice
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Configure models manually'));b&&b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Configure TTS vendor and credential']")?.click();})()

marks.name: Credentials are a switch
marks.why: Off means Agora Managed Key, shown with the shield, included. On reveals a select of saved credentials with No credential selected and Create credential, the way the live NG console's drawer does it.

marks.name: Voice selection lives in the TTS config too
marks.why: The Voice field names the picked voice and opens the Select voice dialog (design 01), like the NG TTS drawer's voice library.

name: after5-add-backup
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Configure models manually'));b&&b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));const adds=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Add backup');adds[0]&&adds[0].click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const sel=document.querySelector('#wz-backup-asr');sel&&sel.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});})()

marks.name: + Add backup beside each vendor
marks.why: A Backup vendor select appears under the field; the primary vendor is listed but disabled, ineligible vendors say why. The pick is the same one the Backup providers row recaps.

marks.name: One door per vendor
marks.why: LLM and TTS get the same ghost button; nothing is set until you pick.

marks.name: Browse voices is a labelled button
marks.why: The Select voice dialog had only the field and an icon as doors; the button says what it opens.
